tools.name: ch_search_connections
tools.description: Search for train connections in Switzerland between two stations. Uses transport.opendata.ch API to provide real-time connection data including departure times, duration, platforms, and transfers.

params.name: is_arrival_time
params.description: If true, interpret 'time' as arrival time (default false).

tools.name: ch_search_stations
tools.description: Search for Swiss train stations by name or location.

tools.name: ch_get_departures
tools.description: Get departure board for a Swiss train station with real-time information.

params.name: datetime
params.description: Datetime ISO string supported by API (optional).

tools.name: ch_nearby_stations
tools.description: Find nearby Swiss train stations based on coordinates (latitude, longitude).

tools.name: be_search_connections
tools.description: Search train connections in Belgium between two stations. Powered by iRail API for real-time routes and schedules.

params.name: results
params.description: Max number of connections to return (default 4).

tools.name: be_search_stations
tools.description: Search for Belgian train stations by name.

tools.name: be_get_departures
tools.description: Get live departure board for a Belgian train station.

tools.name: be_get_vehicle
tools.description: Get details about a specific Belgian train vehicle by its ID.

params.name: vehicle_id
params.description: Vehicle ID from iRail. Example: 'BE.NMBS.IC1234' (format may vary)

tools.name: no_search_places
tools.description: Autocomplete search across stops/addresses/POIs in Norway via Entur Geocoder.

tools.name: no_stop_departures
tools.description: Upcoming departures for a StopPlace ID (e.g., 'NSR:StopPlace:58368').

tools.name: no_trip
tools.description: Door-to-door trip planning between two StopPlaces (NSR IDs).

tools.name: no_nearest_stops
tools.description: Find nearest StopPlaces for a coordinate (lat, lon) within a radius in meters.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of stops to return (default 10).
